security.title: Security Architecture
security.subtitle: Enterprise identity governance & BFF token lifecycle.
security.cookie_desc: JWT access tokens and opaque refresh session tokens are stored strictly inside HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax browser cookies. They are never written to localStorage or sessionStorage.
security.hashing_desc: Argon2id primary hashing with cryptographically unique salts. Server-side session revocation ensures instant session termination upon logout.
